newsitem.title: CANADA: Minorca says not affected by Busang talks.
newsitem.headline: Minorca says not affected by Busang talks.

text.p: Minorca Resources Inc said on Tuesday that any discussions between Bre-X Minerals Ltd and Barrick Gold Corp would not affect Minorca's interests in Indonesia.
Minorca has a financing agreement with Indonesia's PT Askatindo Karya Mineral, which has a 10 percent interest in the huge Busang gold deposit in Indonesia.
Askatindo would not be affected by joint-venture negotiations between Bre-X and Barrick, Minorca said.
It said it met with Askatindo in Jakarta today and Askatindo reconfirmed that it has no intention to sell its 10 percent holding in Busang.
